project_sidewalk.description: Museum District: wide continuous sidewalks, high ADA curb-ramp density, signalized crosswalks.
project_sidewalk.why_rating: The Museum District is among Houston's premier pedestrian corridors. Sidewalks along Portland Street and Montrose Boulevard measure 5 to 6 feet wide in poured concrete, with truncated-dome tactile pavers and dual ADA curb ramps at each corner. Cross-slopes remain under 2%, and zero pathway obstacles were logged on walks to the nearby medical center and retail destinations.

audit_breakdown.curb_ramps_status: Dual ADA curb ramps with tactile paving at all street corners
audit_breakdown.surface_condition: Smooth, level concrete with minimal expansion joint wear
audit_breakdown.path_clearance: Clear roll width exceeding 48 inches across all primary corridors
